actions.detective: Compare dependency-changing commits against associated statuses/runs and LKG-related workflow paths.
actions.preventive: Require post-change execution before inheriting prior LKG/checkout assurance.
actions.precautionary: Keep runtime/release promotion unchanged and claim_allowed=false until evidence exists.
actions.adaptive: Recompute lifecycle validity after dependency changes without rewriting previous PASS history.
actions.maintenance: Classify dependency bump as event-triggered maintenance requiring revalidation.
actions.incident_investigation: No incident observed; preserve as change-triggered gap, not incident.
actions.safety_assurance: Acquire a terminal post-change run and compare outputs/hashes with the prior baseline.
actions.learning_anti_recurrence: Treat future CI-action changes touching bootstrap, checkout, signing or artifact custody as automatic assurance-invalidating events.

falsifier: A terminal post-change run that executes the affected checkout/cache steps, preserves expected bootstrap/artifact hashes and passes the relevant gates without regression closes this gap for the observed commit set.
next_probe: Run or observe beta-build and cross-domain gates on a commit containing the dependency bumps; capture run_id, jobs, steps, exit codes, bootstrap hashes and artifacts.
mitigation: Fail closed on assurance inheritance; do not classify the dependency bump itself as failure or success.
review_or_expiry: Reopen on any subsequent change to checkout/cache/bootstrap/signing/artifact-custody dependencies.
